_template: Agent hook: a subagent with Read/Grep/Glob (up to 50 turns) checks the work before the turn ends. Claude Code only, experimental. Costs a model run on every Stop: scope the prompt to a concrete, checkable condition.

hooks.prompt:
Verify the agent's claimed result before it stops. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

Read last_assistant_message. For each file it says it changed, open the file and confirm the change is present and complete (no TODO stubs, no placeholder bodies). Respond {"ok": true} when every claim holds, otherwise {"ok": false, "reason": "<the first claim that does not hold, and where>"}.
